en.tagline: Generate AI videos from text, images, and references
en.summary: This skill runs AI video models through the belt CLI from inference.sh. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, avatars and lipsync, video editing, upscaling, and sound effects. You pick a model by its app ID and pass a JSON input.
problem: Video models come from many providers, each with its own inputs and settings. Without a shared interface, you must learn each one separately to make a single clip.
With this skill, one CLI and one command pattern cover the models listed. You choose a model by app ID, such as google/veo-3-1-fast or bytedance/seedance-2-5, and change only the JSON input.
unfit: You cannot use the belt CLI or do not have an inference.sh login.
You need only still images. The image generation skill covers that.
steps: Choose a model by app ID from the text-to-video, image-to-video, avatar, or editing tables.
Build a JSON input with fields such as prompt, image, audio, or video, depending on the model.
Run the app with `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`.
Add upscaling, sound effects, or clip merging with the utility apps, such as falai/topaz-video-upscaler, infsh/mmaudio, and infsh/media-merger.
List the available video apps with `belt app list --category video`.

zh.tagline: 通过 belt CLI 生成 AI 视频
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 AI 视频模型。支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生视频、数字人与口型同步、视频编辑、超分和音效生成。你用应用 ID 选择模型，再传入 JSON 输入。
problem: 视频模型来自不同厂商，每个模型的输入和参数都不一样。如果没有统一的接口，要做一段视频就得分别学习每个模型。
用了这个技能，同一套 CLI 和命令格式就能调用列出的模型。你只需换一个应用 ID，例如 google/veo-3-1-fast 或 bytedance/seedance-2-5，并修改 JSON 输入即可。
fit: 讲解视频和 AI 数字人
unfit: 无法使用 belt CLI，或没有 inference.sh 账号。
只需要静态图片。这种情况应使用图片生成技能。
steps: 从文生视频、图生视频、数字人或编辑的表格中，按应用 ID 选择模型。
根据模型需要，准备包含 prompt、image、audio 或 video 等字段的 JSON 输入。
运行 `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'` 执行应用。
如需超分、添加音效或合并片段，可使用 falai/topaz-video-upscaler、infsh/mmaudio 和 infsh/media-merger 等工具应用。
运行 `belt app list --category video` 查看可用的视频应用。
